englishTranslation: Fresh spring rolls with shrimp and pork
atAGlance: Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt is fresh rolls with shrimp and pork, usually with rice paper, herbs, noodles, lettuce, and peanut or fish sauce.
whatItIs: Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt is a fresh rice-paper roll with shrimp, pork, herbs, lettuce, and noodles. Peanut-hoisin dip makes it nutty and rich, while nước chấm keeps it lighter.
howToEnjoy: Eat the rolls cool, dipping each bite in peanut-hoisin or nước chấm depending on the shop. The rice paper should stay soft and the herbs should taste fresh.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi cuốn tôm thịt by the plate or by the roll, then choose the dip. Ask about peanuts before choosing peanut-hoisin if allergies matter.
worthKnowing: This is the classic fresh roll: shrimp, pork, herbs, noodles, and rice paper, a lighter counterpoint to fried spring rolls.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
